en: A sepia-toned postcard view of a small town in a mountain valley. A straight road runs through the center, lined with trees, walls, and a few pedestrians. On both sides are early-20th‑century houses with tiled roofs and balconies. In the mid‑distance stands a church with a tall bell tower, and behind the town rise wooded hills and higher mountains. The lower border of the card bears a caption identifying the place.
